minutes.headline: Zoning Board granted a special permit for a garage addition at 30 Laura Lane, with a reduced garage width
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard an application from the Jordans for a special permit for dimensional variation on a house on Lake Whalom. The relief sought was for building height and for the side yard setback to add a breezeway and two-car garage. Board members questioned the size of the garage, the applicant offered to narrow it, and the board moved and seconded a grant with modified relief.

public_comment.topic: The chair asked for public comment; no members of the public were present.

votes.motion: Grant a special permit for two dimensional variations as modified: height of about 30 feet and a side yard relief of about six and a half feet.

decisions.decision: The applicant agreed to reduce the garage width by four feet, increasing the side setback to about nine feet.
The chair announced the special permit was approved, with standard conditions on compliance, recording at the Registry of Deeds and a two-year lapse.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals approved a special permit for a garage addition at 30 Laura Lane, with the relief modified from what was first sought.
The motion granted two dimensional variations as modified, for building height and side yard setback; the minutes mark the vote as not audible.
The applicant agreed to make the garage four feet narrower, which widens the side setback to about nine feet.
Board members had questioned the size of the garage and its distance from abutters before the applicant offered the change.
No members of the public were present when the chair asked for comment.

why_it_matters: The decision shows how the board trims a request for relief from setback rules, here by narrowing a garage, and the same approach can apply to other lakeside lots with tight side yards.
watch_next: The permit is to be recorded at the Registry of Deeds and lapses after two years if it is not used.
